title: Conditional and mapped types — concept map
intro: T extends U ? X : Y conditionals, infer extraction, mapped types with key remapping, template literal strings, and distributive pitfalls — the type-level programming toolkit behind lib.d.ts utilities.

conceptCards.title: Conditional types
conceptCards.summary: T extends U ? X : Y — type-level if/else. Powers Exclude and nested chains.
conceptCards.example: type Exclude<T,U> = T extends U ? never : T

conceptCards.title: infer keyword
conceptCards.summary: Capture type in extends clause. ReturnType, Parameters, Awaited built on infer.
conceptCards.example: T extends Promise<infer U> ? U : T

conceptCards.title: Mapped types
conceptCards.summary: [K in keyof T] iterates keys. as clause remaps or filters with never.

conceptCards.title: Template literal types
conceptCards.summary: Backtick unions. Capitalize/Uppercase intrinsics. Cartesian explosion risk.

conceptCards.title: Distributive pitfalls
conceptCards.summary: Union T distributes by default. [T] extends [U] disables. ToArray footgun.
